title: Evaluation field for the integral tensor presentation
statement: For flat complexes P and S and a K-injective I, every Hom-complex map q from S to Hom(P,I) has a total-tensor representative β satisfying the signed sectionwise evaluation formula and the comparison square for the chosen adjunction.

proof.text: Choose the representative supplied by the Hom-complex evaluation construction; the signed sectionwise formula and comparison square are the required normalization fields.
